problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $X$ has the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ shown in the table below, compute $P(X\ge 5.5).$

| $x$ | $1.5$ | $2.5$ | $3.5$ | $4.5$ | $5.5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $F(x)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $\frac{5}{8}$ | $1$ |
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

To solve the given problem, we can use the rule

$$
P(X>a)=1-P(X\le a)=1-F(a).
$$

Here, we want to compute $P(X\ge 5.5).$ However, this interval is stated in the form $X\ge 5.5,$ not $X>5.5.$

So first, we must convert the interval $X\ge 5.5$ to the form $X>a.$ Looking at the given possible values of $X,$ we see that $X\ge 5.5$ is equivalent to $X>4.5.$

Therefore, in our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge 5.5) & =P(X>4.5) \\  & =1-P(X\le 4.5) \\  & =1-F(4.5) \\  & =1-\frac{5}{8} \\  & =\frac{3}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
